channel.title: SWK Properties Journal
channel.description: UAE property buyer guides and market notes.

item.title: How to read a developer's track record before you reserve
item.description: A launch brochure shows intent. A handed-over community shows what the developer actually does. Here is how to check the second before you commit to the first.

item.title: Escrow, Oqood and the off-plan paper trail
item.description: Three pieces of paperwork protect most off-plan buyers in Dubai. Here is what each one is, what it does, and what to keep.

item.title: Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah: choose the emirate before the project
item.description: Developers such as Emaar, Aldar and Arada have made it possible to buy in three emirates from one conversation. The decision that matters comes first: which emirate fits your plan.

item.title: Read a payment plan like a cash-flow schedule
item.description: A payment plan is a timetable of obligations. Turning it into your own cash-flow calendar shows whether it works before you sign.

item.title: Branded residences: what the name adds, and what it cannot
item.description: From Dorchester Collection on Palm Jumeirah to Mercedes-Benz in Downtown, the UAE has become a market for brand-named homes. Here is how to think about the premium.

item.title: Questions to ask at the sales gallery, and the answers that should worry you
item.description: A sales gallery is built to make you feel good. These questions turn the visit into a fact-finding session.

item.title: Buying from abroad: a checklist for non-resident buyers
item.description: Many SWK clients buy from India, Pakistan, Russia and the UK without visiting first. This checklist covers what to line up before you transfer a dirham.

item.title: Off-plan or ready in Dubai? Start with the date you need the keys
item.description: A practical comparison of cash flow, handover uncertainty and the checks to make before choosing a Dubai property.

item.title: Dubai property Golden Visa: questions to settle before you buy
item.description: Understand the property route, check mortgage documentation and separate a purchase decision from a residency application.

item.title: Comparing Dubai rental yields: five neighbourhoods, one honest worksheet
item.description: A practical way to compare JVC, Business Bay, Dubai Marina, Dubai Hills and Dubai South without relying on unsupported yield rankings.
